captions.detailed: This 3D model features a dual-chamber dropper seatpost with a black anodized finish, supporting a wide, dark comfort saddle. The assembly consists of a thick outer tube containing a side-mounted remote activation cable port, an inner post that telescopes vertically on a prismatic joint, and a central lockout collar with a lever that pivots on a revolute joint. At the top of the inner post is a two-bolt saddle clamp head holding two steel cradle rails, allowing the saddle to tilt on a revolute pivot for angle adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dual-chamber dropper seatpost with an adjustable saddle. The model should feature a large-diameter outer tube with a side-mounted cable port, an inner post that slides vertically, a mid-point lockout collar with a pivoting lever, and a black comfort saddle mounted on steel rails with a tilt-adjustable clamp head.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner post using concentric Cylinder primitives, defining a prismatic joint between them. Model the lockout collar as a cylinder with a smaller pivot pin and a thin rectangular lever, attaching it via a revolute joint. Build the saddle clamp head at the top of the inner post using combined Box shapes for the lower/upper clamps and cylindrical bolts. Finally, construct the saddle shell by lofting or extruding a wide, contoured sketch, attach it to two parallel cylindrical steel rails, and define a revolute joint between the rails and the clamp head for tilt adjustment.
